question: What cosmic act does Lord Śrīkaṇṭha perform through Brahmā?
premises: Desiring withdrawal, he enters the lotus of the four-faced Brahmā.
He creates the worlds again up to the world of Jana.
inference: Śrīkaṇṭha carries out cosmic dissolution and re-creation through Brahmā.
uncertainties: The identity of the four worlds burned is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: When he wishes to withdraw the worlds, he enters the lotus of the four-faced Brahmā, burns the four worlds, and then creates the worlds again up to the world of Jana.
